  keychain entry exists on this Darwin host. Cursor would otherwise emit
  the cryptic `Security process exited with code: 45`.

  See docs/installation-and-setup.md (Cursor section) for setup.

  To fix, choose one:
    (a) export CURSOR_API_KEY=<your-cursor-api-key>
    (b) security delete-generic-password -a cursor-user 2>/dev/null; cursor login
  ```
